summary: Backend + frontend testing of Sauna Price Import HISTORY + ROLLBACK feature. 12/12 backend pytest cases passed covering auth gating, list (sorted desc, no snapshot blobs, dealer-scoped), rollback (price restore, override restore, double-rollback 400, unknown id 404), DELETE, and that commit returns historyId. Frontend: 'История' button shown next to Импорт/Экспорт on SaunaPricingPage (Ceny > Sauny), opens history-dialog with 6 entries listing date, adminUsername, filename, summary chip. Откачен badge correctly rendered on all rolled-back rows (rolledBack flag from backend reflected in UI).
critical_code_review_comments: Cap-50 history prune in commit_import_sauna_prices deletes oldest entries regardless of their rolledBack state — could prune an entry mid-investigation; consider preferring to prune rolledBack==true entries first.
DELETE endpoint allows deleting non-rolled-back entries which loses snapshots; consider blocking or warning unless rolledBack.
seed_data_creation: Tests create temporary history entries via commit, then rollback to keep DB clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests cover global + dealer-scoped flows. Frontend was verified at Panel Administracyjny -> Ceny -> Sauny: the History button + dialog work. Active rollback buttons cannot be exercised live unless a fresh commit happens (all current entries were rolled back by tests). To exercise the rollback click flow end-to-end, do a fresh CSV/Excel import via UI first.
